texts.zh:
我们发现了和在[From.GetName]上的外星文明有关的文物！我们的科学家认为他们在六百万年前居住在这片星系，这些外星人自称“尤特”人。他们体型巨大且看起来像扁平的节肢动物。

这一物种成年之后体长接近百米，显然鲜有一艘飞船上能够有两名甚至三名尤特人乘客。
texts.en:
We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! Our scientists think they inhabited this region of stars roughly six million years ago, based on the age of the artifacts. The aliens called themselves the "Yuht" and appear to have been very large and flat arthropod analogues.

It seems a single individual could reach a length of nearly a hundred meters as an adult, and it was apparently exceedingly rare for more than two or three Yuht to travel aboard the same starship.

texts.zh:
我们已经找到了一些来自尤特帝国的史前古器物。他们是一种大约六百万年以前占据一部分星系的外星文明。在生理上，亚特人是一种非常大而扁平的节肢类动物。一个成年亚特的体型可以长到一百米，这使得两个或者三个以上的亚特乘坐同一艘飞船进行星际旅行是一件非常罕见的事情。

如果我们能找到更多他们文明的遗物，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母恒星系的位置。
texts.en:
We have recovered artifacts from the Yuht Empire. They were an alien civilization that inhabited a portion of the galaxy roughly six million years ago. Physically the Yuht were very large and flat arthropod analogues. A single individual could reach a length of nearly a hundred meters as an adult, and it was apparently exceedingly rare for more than two or three Yuht to travel aboard the same starship.

If we can find enough relics from their civilization, it may be possible to pinpoint the location of their home system.

title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Yuht

texts.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求尤特的知识并为我们所用。
texts.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Yuht to our own.

notes.zh: 另行花费750稀有文物开启，要求已发现尤特母星且尚未开始该研究。社会学项目无期限；完成报告按思潮与科技资格显示互斥正文和奖励回应。
notes.en: Spend 750 minor artifacts separately after finding the Yuht homeworld, provided this research has not already been started. The society project has no expiration. Its report and reward depend on ethics and technology eligibility.

texts.zh:
尤特有一套可以高效清除其孵化场星球上敌对异种生物的工序。我们已经成功恢复了这一净化工序。

这确实会对生物圈造成或多或少惹人非议的短期影响，但一旦其恢复完好，这颗行星应该会更符合我们的需求。
texts.en:
The Yuht had efficient processes for removing hostile xeno presences from their hatchery worlds. We have successfully recreated this cleansing process.

It does have some concerning short term effects on the biosphere, but once it recovers, the planet should be more suitable to our needs.

texts.zh:
我们已经设法重现了尤特过去用于预处理其孵化场星球的净化工序。

这确实会对生物圈造成或多或少惹人非议的短期影响，但一旦其恢复完好，这颗行星应该会更符合我们的需求。
texts.en:
We have managed to recreate the cleansing process that the Yuht would use to prepare their hatchery worlds.

It does have some concerning short term effects on the biosphere, but once it recovers, the planet should be more suitable to our needs.

texts.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

sections.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]在很久之前被轨道轰炸过，对生态环境造成了巨大的破坏。[From.GetPlanetMoon]是古代尤特人建造的小型前哨，但是为何这一举动会使整个世界招致毁灭性的灾难还是一个谜。
texts.en: [From.GetName] was subjected to extensive orbital bombardment at some point in the distant past, during which the biosphere suffered catastrophic damage. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] appears to have been home to a small outpost built by the ancient Yuht, but why that would warrant the devastation of an entire world is a mystery.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]已经被确定为一颗曾作为尤特的孵化场的行星，它们的幼崽被遗留在这里，任其自然成长。一次考察行动必然会让我们获得很多有价值的化石。
texts.en: [From.GetName] has been identified as a former Yuht hatchery world, where their infants were left to slowly mature on their own. An archaeological dig on this world is certain to produce valuable fossils.

texts.zh: 在对[From.From.GetName]进行深入研究之后，我们得知[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]是尤特帝国的几个“居住站”之一。负责育种的部门先用绝育的方式将星球上的捕食者和其他潜在危险生物全部除掉，然后才在地表产卵。孵化后的这些尤特人会在这个相对安全的星球环境下独自生存几百年直到他们进化出某种程度的智慧。这时他们才会被接纳进入尤特帝国。
texts.en:
After extensive studies of [From.From.GetName], we now know that the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon] served as one of several "hatchery worlds" in the Yuht Empire. Their Ministry of Breeding prepared worlds by sterilizing them of predators and other potentially harmful elements before planting eggs on the surface.

The Yuht hatchlings were then left on their own in this relatively safe environment for several centuries until they developed a level of near-sapience. Only then were they collected and carefully introduced into society.

texts.zh: 在经过我们对尤特飞船的进一步研究后，[Root.Capital.GetName]的科学家已经定位了尤特文明的母星系-尤特安！我们应该抢在别人前头探索那个星系。
texts.en: After intense study of our recovered Yuht artifacts, scientists on [Root.Capital.GetName] have managed to deduce the exact galactic coordinates of Yuhtaan - the home system of the ancient Yuht civilization! We should launch an expedition to this system before someone else beats us to it.

texts.zh: 我们发现了失落已久的尤特文明母星系的位置。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明母星系的秘密之前派科研船去探索那里！
texts.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the Yuht home system. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

texts.zh: 尤特的古老母星的坐标已最终定位。
texts.en: The ancient homeworld of the Yuht has finally been located.

notes.zh: 六份线索完成后定位母星。首次生成若暂缺合适星系，每30天重试；成功或找到已有星系时，两天后收到通知。通知结束线索搜集并开启母星调查项目，尚不代表调查完成。
notes.en: Six clues locate the home system. If initial placement has no suitable system, it retries every 30 days. Successful placement or an existing system leads to a notice after two days. The notice ends clue collection and opens the homeworld project; investigation is still required.

texts.zh:
我们已经确认[FromFrom.GetName]是尤特的母星。四百万年前这个[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]遭受了大规模的轨道炮击，表面上如今只留有卷曲的金属骨架废墟，而这些骨架曾经是巨大理想城市群的一部分。

根据现有信息，在一百万年间，尤特人用大部分时间去搜寻到外星智能生命，但一无所获。当他们最终遇上贾巴蒂尼人时，这个刚刚才进入太空时代的年轻物种，把那些尤特人都快吓坏了。

尤特的领袖们达成共识：必须在贾巴蒂尼人变得更有威胁之前摧毁他们。一场大型袭击就这样开始了，这场战役使双方都元气大伤。虽然年轻，但是贾巴蒂尼人已经在试验尤特人做梦都没想到的全新技术。最终他们翻盘，占据了上风。在不到十年间的战役中，有着两百万年历史的尤特帝国最终被完全摧毁。
texts.en:
We have confirmed that [FromFrom.GetName] was the original homeworld of the Yuht. The [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon] suffered extensive orbital bombardment roughly four million years ago. Twisted metal skeletons are all that remain of the massive arcologies that once covered the surface.

From what we can piece together, it seems the Yuht spent the better part of a million years searching local space in vain for signs of intelligent alien life. When they finally encountered the Jabbardeeni, a young race that had only recently achieved interstellar travel, their alien psychology was a tremendous shock.

The Yuht leadership reached a consensus: the Jabbardeeni had to be eradicated before they grew too powerful. A massive surprise attack was launched, which was beaten back at great cost for both sides. Despite their young age, the Jabbardeeni were already experimenting with technologies the Yuht had never considered, and eventually they gained the upper hand. After less than a decade of warfare, the two million year old Yuht Empire was utterly destroyed.

tooltips.zh: 解锁稀有文物行动：尤特的秘密
tooltips.en: Minor Artifact Action Unlocked: Secrets of the Yuht

label.zh: 拥有《四海皆臣》：720–1800天后发现贾巴迪尼储藏处
label.en: With Overlord: Jabbardeeni cache discovered after 720–1800 days

texts.zh: 对从[yuhtaan.GetName]星系取回的数据进行进一步分析发现，在其背景噪音中存在一个微妙的能量模式，源自小行星[jabbardeeni_cache.GetName]。
texts.en: Further analysis of the data recovered from the [yuhtaan.GetName] system has revealed a subtle repeating energy pattern hidden in the background noise, coming from the asteroid [jabbardeeni_cache.GetName].

texts.zh: 一种微弱而重复的能量特征，每当有舰船驶过该恒星系时就会从这个小行星中发出。
texts.en: A subtle repeating energy pattern emanates from this asteroid any time ships travel through the system.

label.zh: 科研船与科学家完成研究：基础360天，无到期限制
label.en: Science ship and scientist complete research: base 360 days, no expiration

texts.zh:
一座历史可追溯回尤特-贾巴蒂尼大战时代的小型监听哨站，它在开战后不久就由贾巴蒂尼人建造，用来观测[yuhtaan.GetName]，以防尤特人返回他们的母星系，而在这个小行星的内部深处暗藏着大量数据缓存。

在随后的数个世纪中，贾巴蒂尼人又将这个哨站改建成了一个用于进行他们在超光速航行中最新实验的测试场所。尽管这些数据大多数仅仅是理论上的，但仍有一些可以派上用场。
texts.en:
A small listening outpost dating back to the ancient Yuht-Jabbardeeni conflict with a substantial data cache was hidden deep within the asteroid, built by the Jabbardeeni after the war to observe [yuhtaan.GetName] in case any Yuht returned to their home system.

In the centuries that followed, the Jabbardeeni repurposed the outpost into a testing site for some of their more novel experiments in faster-than-light travel. While the data is mostly theoretical, some may still be of use.

texts.zh: 我们发现了尤特的古代母星。但是，在我们之前已经有人造访了那里。他们已经将[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]洗劫一空。
texts.en: We have discovered the ancient homeworld of the Yuht, but alas, someone else must have recently paid a visit to this world. The [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon] has been stripped clean of anything of value.

texts.zh: 我们对于[FromFrom.GetName]的调查显示[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]曾经是名为“尤特”一族的母星。这里已经被其他的星际旅行者造访过，并且他们把[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]上有价值的东西都带走了。
texts.en: Our survey of [FromFrom.GetName] has revealed that the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon] was once the homeworld of an ancient species known as the "Yuht." This system was recently visited by other interstellar travelers, however, and they appear to have picked the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon] clean of anything of value.

tooltips.zh: 解锁稀有文物行动：尤特的秘密
tooltips.en: Minor Artifact Action Unlocked: Secrets of the Yuht

texts.zh: [From.GetName]的考古学家们已经设法推断出尤特母星系的秘密坐标！
texts.en: Archeologists from the [From.GetName] have managed to deduce the secret location of the Yuht home system!

texts.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

sections.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]发现了数个大型监听阵列，这些建筑有数百万年的历史，我们相信这是尤特文明建造的。看起来在过去的50万年的时间里，至少有一个外星文明曾经改变这个阵列的用途，让它们为己所用。这些巨大的接受天线已经完全损毁，无法修复，不过有些终端设备依然完好无损。
texts.en: We have discovered several massive listening arrays on [From.GetName]. These arrays are millions of years old and we believe they were originally built by the Yuht, though it appears at least one other alien civilization repurposed them at some point in the last 500,000 years for their own needs. The colossal receiving dishes are beyond repair, but some terminals are still intact.

texts.zh: 尤特百万年前在这里建造了大量巨大的监听阵列。虽然早已失效，但附近的考古挖掘还是会有大发现的。
texts.en: Several massive listening arrays were built on this world by the Yuht millions of years ago. Though they have long since stopped working, an archaeological excavation of the surrounding area could produce significant findings.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.From.GetName]上的考古学家们发现建立在那里的监听阵列是用来寻找外星智慧生命的——尤特人从来没有发现过外星智慧生命。恢复了电脑终端的一部分电力之后，考古学家得到了装有几百年来监听阵列记录日志的数据盘。这些日志表明在尤特帝国时代，这一片星系确实没有其他智慧生命。
texts.en:
Our archaeologists on [From.From.GetName] have learned that the listening arrays built there were used to scan space for any signs of intelligent alien life - something the Yuht had never once encountered.

After managing to partially restore power to a computer terminal, the archaeologists acquired a data disc with log files from the sensor array stretching over centuries. These logs suggest that this section of the galaxy was indeed devoid of sapient life at the time of the Yuht Empire.

texts.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

sections.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]的南半球发现了数座尤特生态建筑的遗迹，这表明[From.GetPlanetMoon]曾是他们的主要殖民地之一。

在其中一座崩坏的建筑中，我们的地面小组发现了一个曾经展出“著名假外星物品”的博物馆遗址。这些都是尤特从帝国各处收集来的，声称能证明外星生物存在的人工制品。博物馆将这些假货一一拆穿。
texts.en:
The ruins of several dozen massive Yuht arcologies can be found in the southern hemisphere of [From.GetName], indicating that this [From.GetPlanetMoon] was one of their major colonies.

Inside one of the crumbling buildings our ground team discovered the remains of what appears to be a museum exhibiting "famous alien frauds." These are various artifacts collected by Yuht from throughout their empire, claimed to prove the existence of sapient alien life. In each case, the museum has debunked the artifacts as frauds.

texts.zh: 一座主题为“外星骗局”的尤特博物馆遗址被发现在[From.GetName]的地表上。它曾展出过数十种被认为是外星的文物，我们的考古专家对其所剩的那些文物仍然充满兴趣。
texts.en: An ancient Yuht museum dedicated to "alien frauds" was discovered on [From.GetName]. It once exhibited dozens of supposedly alien artifacts, and our archaeologists would like to study the few that still remain.

texts.zh: 在[From.From.GetName]的尤特博物馆所展出的大部分文物都丢失了，但我们的考古学家还是成功回收了一件被认为是“赝品”的文物。这件文物似乎是用来测量宇宙辐射的，但考古学家确定这件文物的出现时间比尤特帝国早几百万年。看来尤特博物馆搞错了，因为这件所谓的“赝品”其实是货真价实的外星文物。
texts.en: Most of the artifacts exhibited by the Yuht museums on [From.From.GetName] are missing, but our archaeologists managed to recover one of these supposed frauds. It seems to be an instrument used for measuring cosmic radiation, but the archaeologists have confirmed that it predates the Yuht by several million years. Contrary to the opinion of the Yuht museum, this would indeed seem to be an authentic alien artifact.

texts.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

sections.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]随处可见尤特的发展踪迹，[From.GetPlanetMoon]显然曾经面临土地紧缺的困境，北半球有一个区域似乎曾经是巨大的墓地，附近没有任何尤特住宅，但是却有许多纪念碑。由于尤特人的生育率很低下，并且有着近千年的平均寿命，每个尤特人的死亡都会被郑重对待，下葬仪式也是非常的隆重。
texts.en:
Signs of Yuht development can be found all across [From.GetName], and the [From.GetPlanetMoon] must have experienced limited terraforming at some point. One region in the northern hemisphere is some kind of massive graveyard. No Yuht settlements can be found nearby, but there are many monuments marking burial sites.

With a low birthrate and an average lifespan close to a thousand years, each Yuht death was treated as a significant event and much emphasis was placed on burial ceremonies.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]曾是一片繁荣的尤特殖民地，而且我们已经确认看似是巨型墓场的地方实际上是[From.GetPlanetMoon]的一块独立的区域。显然针对这一地点开展一次考古挖掘行动是有价值的。
texts.en: [From.GetName] was once home to a thriving Yuht colony, and we have identified what appears to be a massive graveyard in an isolated region of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]. It may be worth the effort to establish an archaeological excavation site there.

texts.zh: 在[From.From.GetName]的考古挖掘表明绝大多数墓穴在这数百万年来已经被盗墓者所掠夺，因为尤特人喜欢用珠宝和其他昂贵的奢侈品作为陪葬。在盗墓者所遗留下来的东西中，考古学家发现了一个和成年尤特人很相像的玩具娃娃，他们认为这个玩具娃娃很可能是好运符或者某种纪念品。
texts.en: The archaeological digs on [From.From.GetName] have revealed that most of the graves were looted in the millions of years since they were first dug, likely as a result of the Yuht custom of burying their dead with jewelry and other extravagant gifts. In a pile of things discarded by the looters, the archaeologists found a large doll resembling an adult Yuht. They speculate that it may have served as a good luck charm or memento of some kind.

texts.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

sections.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]发生了一场大型战役。参加战斗双方是尤特人和一个我们不怎么了解的种群。这场战役是在尤特帝国末日时期发生的。虽然这场战役发生在几百万年前，但是战争留下的废墟依然可见。虽然[From.GetPlanetMoon]是尤特的一个重要的殖民地，他们的城市和外围建筑却从来没有在战斗后重建，这似乎说明他们输了这场战斗。
texts.en:
A massive ground war was fought on [From.GetName] between the Yuht and a second species that we know little of. This campaign took place in the final years of the Yuht Empire, and though it occurred millions of years ago, wreckage of ruined war machines can still be found.

Although the [From.GetPlanetMoon] was an important Yuht colony, their cities and outlying settlements were never rebuilt after the fighting ceased, which would seem to indicate that they ultimately lost the campaign.

texts.zh: 数百万年前，[From.GetName]上曾爆发了一场尤特与其他种族之间的毁灭性地面战争。我们的考古学家很乐意去搜索古战场，以发掘有价值的文物。
texts.en: Millions of years ago, [From.GetName] was the scene of a devastating ground campaign between the Yuht and another species. Our archaeologists would like to scour the ancient battlefields for valuable artifacts.

texts.zh: 在对[From.From.GetName]的几处古战场进行深入挖掘勘探后，我们的考古学家挖出了尤特人作战时用的载具，上面仍连接有几门大口径的火炮。考古学家认为，尤特士兵由于体型巨大，在战场上的他们就如同一座座大型的移动堡垒。
texts.en: After combing through several of the ancient battlefields on [From.From.GetName], our archaeologists recovered what appears to be a Yuht battle harness. Several large-caliber cannons were still attached to it, and the archaeologists theorize that Yuht soldiers, given the massive size of their bodies, fought as what can essentially be described as large mobile fortresses.

texts.zh: 这颗气态巨行星附近有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization in the vicinity of this gas giant.

sections.zh: 这颗气态巨行星附近有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization in the vicinity of this gas giant.

texts.zh: 一个尤特人发射的卫星围绕在[From.GetName]上以纪念他们和贾巴蒂尼人的第一次接触，贾巴蒂尼是一个短暂存在的文明。这事情发生在[From.GetStarName]星系里，对于尤特帝国的各个方面都有重大影响。过去一百万年间，他们觉得自己是宇宙中的孤儿，所以当他们发现有别的智慧生命存在时，他们又是敬畏又是恐慌。[Root.GetName]复原了卫星，现在卫星等着我们进行全面的分析。
texts.en:
A Yuht satellite was placed in orbit around [From.GetName] to commemorate the moment of first contact between their empire and the Jabbardeeni, a contemporary civilization. This event occurred right here in the [From.GetStarName] system, and had a profound impact on all levels of Yuht society.

For over a million years they had thought themselves alone in the galaxy, and the Yuht reacted with both awe and horror upon the discovery of sapient alien life. The [Root.GetName] has recovered the satellite, which now awaits a full analysis.

texts.zh: 尤特在[From.GetName]的轨道上，放置了一颗卫星，以纪念与外星智慧生物的首次接触。一队考古学家申请资金对它进行全面分析。
texts.en: The Yuht placed a satellite in orbit of [From.GetName] to commemorate the first time they encountered another sapient alien species. A team of archaeologists have requested resources to conduct a full analysis of it.

texts.zh: 我们从[From.From.GetName]回收了卫星并对其进行分析，考古学家发现了一张照片，照片中是一艘尤特巡洋舰和一只相对较小的贾巴蒂尼侦察飞船在第一次接触中相遇的场景。这张照片让我们大概知道了他们星舰的样子。
texts.en: After analyzing the satellite we recovered above [From.From.GetName], our archaeologists found an ingrained, highly stylized picture of what appears to be a Yuht cruiser and a much smaller Jabbardeeni scout in close formation during the first contact event. This has given us some notion of what their starships looked like.

texts.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

sections.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

texts.zh: 我们发现一艘尤特的巡洋舰环绕在[From.GetName]轨道上，这艘船似乎遭受了猛烈的炮火攻击，但是因为舰体年代久远，这也难以确定。没有迹象表明这艘船装备了超光速引擎，所以它一定是以亚光速穿梭在群星中的。
texts.en: The remains of a Yuht cruiser have been found in orbit around [From.GetName]. It seems to have fallen victim to weapons fire, but given the extreme age of the hulk it is difficult to be certain. There is no indication that the ship was ever equipped with an FTL drive - it must have traveled between stars at sublight speeds.

texts.zh: 一艘尤特巡洋舰经历战斗后，被遗弃在[From.GetName]的轨道上。我们的考古学家想登船分析这艘古船。
texts.en: A derelict Yuht cruiser was apparently abandoned in orbit of [From.GetName] after a battle. Our archaeologists would like to board and analyze what remains of this ancient vessel.

texts.zh: 调查[From.From.GetName]之上废弃的尤特巡洋舰的考古学家传来了报告。巡洋舰中部有两个大型冷冻室，每一个冷冻室用来暂时冷冻一个尤特人。由于尤特人体型巨大，在巡洋舰上这种规模的冷冻室显然是船员使用的标准型号了。船上没有发现任何尤特人遗骸，但考古学家从监控船员生命迹象和医疗情况的电脑中找到了日志。日志中详细提供了和尤特人身体信息有关的宝贵资料。
texts.en:
The archaeologists investigating the derelict Yuht cruiser above [From.From.GetName] have transmitted their report. There are two large cryo chambers in the cruiser's mid-section, designed to house one Yuht each in suspended animation. Given the massive size of Yuht individuals, this was apparently their standard crew complement on vessels of this size.

No Yuht remains were found anywhere on the ship, but the archaeologists managed to recover logs from a computer that monitored the life signs and medical condition of the crew. It has provided valuable data on Yuht physiology.

texts.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

sections.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

texts.zh: 尤特星际飞船的残骸在[From.GetName]高空轨道上被发现了。[Root.GetName]的分初步析指出，这艘船或许是一艘殖民船。就算是巡洋舰级别的尤特星际飞船，也只能容纳一到两个尤特人，这都是因为他们个体太大了。但这艘船有很多的低温舱，每个都有巨大的外骨骼，这些外骨骼可能属于那些尤特殖民者。
texts.en:
The partial remains of an ancient Yuht starship have been found in high orbit over [From.GetName]. An initial analysis conducted by the [Root.GetName] indicate that the vessel may have served as a colony ship.

Even cruiser-sized Yuht ships were typically crewed by only one or two individuals given the immense size of their bodies, but this hulk has more than a dozen cryo-pods attached, each containing withered exoskeletons from what must have been Yuht colonists.

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]的轨道上，发现了尤特殖民船的残骸。如由一队科学家对其进行探索，会有不错的发现。
texts.en: The wreckage of what appears to be a Yuht colony ship was discovered in orbit of [From.GetName]. An analysis of the vessel by a team of archaeologists could yield interesting findings.

texts.zh: 围绕[From.From.GetName]轨道运动的大部分尤特殖民飞船遗骸都残破不堪，考古学家从中成功回收了亚光速引擎。尤特人并没能成功突破光速，他们依靠冷冻技术和长达千年的自然寿命在行星间扩张他们帝国的领域。
texts.en: Most of the remains of the derelict Yuht colony ship that orbits [From.From.GetName] are in poor condition, but our archaeologists managed to recover the vessel's sublight engines. The Yuht never breached the light barrier, depending instead on cryo technology and thousand year long natural life-spans to spread their empire across the stars.

texts.zh: 这颗小行星上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this asteroid.

sections.zh: 这颗小行星上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this asteroid.

texts.zh: 这些小行星好像是一些有尤特人的居所，深度扫描显示在小行星中有一群互通的洞穴，与在别处发现的尤特建筑样式差不多。如果想要了解更多的话我们需要派出远征队探索洞穴。
texts.en: This asteroid appears to have served as the home of a single Yuht individual. Deep scans show a series of connected caves in the asteroid's interior that follow a pattern similar to the rooms seen in ancient Yuht dwellings that have been discovered elsewhere. To learn more we will have to dispatch an away team to investigate the cave system.

texts.zh: 小行星[From.GetName]上似乎有古代尤特居所的遗迹。组织一支远征队，派往调查小行星的洞窟，获取更多情报。
texts.en: Asteroid [From.GetName] appears to house the remains of an ancient Yuht dwelling. An away team must be organized and sent to investigate the asteroid's caverns to learn more about it.

texts.zh: 通过调查在[From.From.GetName]这颗小行星上的尤特人居所，我们发现它是著名哲学隐士“雅克利尔”的家。她在尤特文化中显然是一位名望颇高的人物，不同的尤特考古现场中都能找到关于她的文献记载。雅克利尔的遗骸在居所的主密封舱被发现，她在那里苦等补给船直到死为止，但补给船最终也没有来。
texts.en: After investigating the Yuht dwelling on asteroid [From.From.GetName], we have learned that it was the home of the famous philosopher-hermit "Yakliir." She was evidently a figure of some renown in their culture, and references to her have been found in several different Yuht sources. Yakliir's remains were found by the dwelling's main airlock, where she perished waiting for a scheduled supply shuttle that never arrived.

texts.zh: 此世界曾经是古代尤特族的首都，曾经生生不息的繁华世界如今已经变成阴森恐怖的不毛之地。
texts.en: This world, which served as the capital of the ancient Yuht Empire, once supported life. No longer.

sections.zh: 此世界曾经是古代尤特族的首都，曾经生生不息的繁华世界如今已经变成阴森恐怖的不毛之地。
sections.en: This world, which served as the capital of the ancient Yuht Empire, once supported life. No longer.

summary.text:
# 尤特：漫长的寻找与短暂的战争

## 故事概述
最初的文物指向约六百万年前活跃的尤特文明。这些近百米长的节肢动物拥有千年寿命，依靠冷冻与亚光速航行跨越星际。他们耗费极漫长的时间寻找其他智慧生命，甚至把一件比自己古老数百万年的真实外星仪器误认成赝品。

母星报告最终揭示：当尤特遇到年轻的贾巴蒂尼文明时，长期期待并未化为友善。他们选择先发制人，试图在对手强大之前消灭它。贾巴蒂尼人的技术最终占据上风，不到十年的战争终结了延续两百万年的尤特帝国。

## 阅读顺序与九份证据
玩家先发现尤特痕迹，再调查不同遗址。九条调查各自经历发现、项目、报告，任意完成六份线索后才能定位母星；以下编号用于辨认证据，不是必经顺序。

1. 506：孵化世界先清除捕食者等危险因素，幼体独自生活数世纪，接近智慧水平后才被引入社会。
2. 511：监听阵列记录了数世纪的搜寻。英文说这些记录“表明可能”当地当时没有智慧生命，不能扩展为整个银河绝无其他文明。
3. 516：博物馆里的所谓赝品其实是古老的外星辐射测量仪，早于尤特数百万年。
4. 521：遭盗掘的墓地留下一个成年尤特外形的玩偶；护符或纪念品只是考古学家的推测。
5. 526：带有重炮的战斗装备支持“移动堡垒”般作战的推测。英文称其为穿戴式战斗装备，中文称为载具。
6. 531：卫星保存的风格化图像描绘尤特巡洋舰与较小的贾巴蒂尼侦察船首次接触。
7. 536：巡洋舰上的两个冷冻室与医疗日志揭示船员配置和生理信息，船上没有遗骸。
8. 541：殖民船的亚光速引擎说明尤特未突破光速，以冷冻技术和长寿支撑星际扩张。
9. 546：哲学隐士雅克利尔死在住所气闸旁，等待一艘始终未到的补给船。原文没有明确交代断供原因，不把它强行写成某次战役的直接后果。

## 母星与后续
601的完整母星报告记载约四百万年前的轨道轰炸，以及尤特—贾巴蒂尼战争。开场六百万年前的文物和这里四百万年前的毁灭指向不同时间，不是同一日期。602是另一种母星调查结果，不应紧接601再次发生。

“尤特的秘密”是可选研究，完成社会学项目后得到10050报告：重现尤特孵化世界的净化工序。排外和非排外描述互斥；科技奖励也依据现有技术与研究资格分支，不能全部叠加。

601另在《四海皆臣》条件下，于720–1800天后触发贾巴蒂尼数据缓存支线。它涉及战后监听站与超光速实验资料，与“尤特的秘密”不是前后相依的研究。该支线已有独立导读。

## 依据及未完成事项
已逐篇人工对照500、九份调查报告506–546、601和10050的中英文正文；读取601/602、10050、YUHT_SECRETS及数据缓存支线脚本。来源为游戏events/precursor_events.txt、events/ancient_relics_arcsite_events_2.txt及相应special_projects文件。

九处遗址各自的发现触发条件和可选研究开启条件尚待逐项审阅；项目完成回调、报告计数与母星定位流程已补充核对。本文是持续维护的故事导读，不是尤特全链或先驱者类别验收完成的声明。

项目核对补记：九个YUHT_ARCHEOLOGY项目均为180天、科研船与科学家要求，分别回调506至546报告及资源事件15055。源码中的skill行被注释，不应宣称有3–5级门槛。母星项目30天，完成时检查全局母星发现标志与目标是否殖民，决定601或602。项目已逐项审读，遗址发现触发与母星生成仍待继续。

母星定位核对补记：yuht_chain计数上限为6；506回应增加一份线索并调用597完成检查。597按全局星系发现标志分派598生成或599已有星系；598没有可用生成位置时30天重试，成功后与599一样两天后进入600。600回应结束遗迹事件链、开启母星事件链与母星项目。已审读这些回调，其余八份报告现已逐项核对：回应均增加一份线索并调用597。异常发现条件仍待逐项核对。

## 遗址如何出现
已逐项读取96_anomaly_categories_precursors.txt的yuht_1_cat至yuht_9_cat。常规异常生成要求星系带precursor_2标志、调查船所属国家非AI、已有yuht_intro及yuht_chain、尚无对应yuht_1至yuht_9标志，目标也未标作precursor_world。生成时立即设置遗址和对应国家标志，成功调查才进入505至545的发现报告。这里的权重add=10不是固定10%的发现概率。

- 1孵化世界、3博物馆、4墓地、5战场：宜居星球。
- 2监听阵列、7巡洋舰、8殖民船：非宜居常规星球。
- 6首次接触卫星：气态巨行星。
- 9隐士居所：小行星。

以上限制决定一次游戏里哪些调查可被发现，不构成九条故事的时间顺序。网站提供全部报告供阅读，没有模拟星系生成。源码中旧的失败/严重失败分派被注释，不能作为当前版本的有效剧情分支。

## 当前审读状态
九份中英文报告、九个研究项目、报告计数、常规异常生成、母星定位与结果分派、秘密研究开启和条件视角已核对。六条打乱顺序的实际阅读路线及数据缓存后续已通过浏览器检查。尚需核对额外线索补给等外围机制、尤特开场分配条件，并完成全部视角及移动端视觉验收；L星门状态关联仍待实现。此状态替代前面按时间追加的过期待办，不代表整个先驱者类别完成。
